scientific_integrity: Self-review mathematical reconstruction and standalone finite numerical diagnostics, with incomplete historical-priority inspection of two relevant articles explicitly acknowledged. Numerical sampling is not proof of an infinite claim.
scientific_limitations: Exact linear single-particle continuum ring with two antipodal repulsive delta interactions; no finite-width barriers, interaction effects, transport response, or nonantipodal optimization. The sharp bound concerns matched half-flux doublets only; the cone is local for fixed level and mean strength.
title: Symmetry-protected magnetic-ring doublets, a sharp imbalance ceiling, and conical splitting
